blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: Byte-Pair Encoding(BPE)等子词符号化方法是现代语言模型的核心组成部分;然而,符号化能力仍然一般由固定合并预算来决定,以heuristic方式选择. 由于较大的词汇增加内存使用和计算成本,选择紧凑而有效的符号清单对于高效的语文模型制作至关重要。 我们研究优化BPE合并预算作为统计模型选择问题,并直接从实体统计中调查\emph{计算最佳合并集}的信息理论标准。 为了进一步改善有限数据条件下的合并选择,我们用从原始数据中生成的合成文本来增强BPE训练公司,为单体和大块分布提供估计. 跨越多科多拉和下游任务的实验表明,使用有原则的词汇选择技术会缩小模型大小,性能几乎没有退化. 我们进一步注意到,合成数据可以产生更好的显示器,特别是在资源少的情况下。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern language models rely on subword tokenization to represent text efficiently. Methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) ( gage-1994-anewalgorithm ; sennrich-etal-2016-neural ) construct vocabularies by iteratively merging frequent symbol pairs, balancing vocabulary size and sequence length. Since tokenization defines the units processed by a model, it affects compression efficiency, computational cost, and downstream performance. However, tokenizer design remains largely heuristic: most systems fix the number of BPE merges in advance, typically ranging from tens to hundreds of thousands depending on the model and linguistic coverage ( brown-2020-language ; touvron-etal-2023-llama ; bai-2023-qwen ) . These choices are rarely principled and are often inherited from prior work or selected through parameter search.
blocks.zh: 现代语言模型依靠子词符号化来高效地代表文本. 诸如Byte-Pair编码(BPE)(gage-1994-anewalgorithm;sennrich-etal-2016-neural)等方法通过迭代合并频繁符号对,平衡词汇大小和序列长度来构建词汇表. 由于符号化定义了模型所处理的单位,它影响了压缩效率,计算成本,以及下游性能. 然而,标致器设计仍然基本保持了heuristic:大多数系统提前固定了BPE合并的数量,一般根据模型和语言覆盖范围(棕-2020-语言;touvron-etal-2023-lama;bai-2023-qwen)从数万到数十万不等. 这些选择很少是原则性的,往往从先前的作品中继承或通过参数搜索选择.

blocks.en: The number of merges controls tokenization granularity and the tradeoff between vocabulary size and sequence length ( kudo-2018-subword ) . Too few merges create fragmented representations and long sequences, while too many produce large vocabularies capturing spurious or domain-specific patterns. This tradeoff affects efficiency, as longer sequences increase transformer attention costs, whereas large vocabularies increase embedding and decoding overhead.
blocks.zh: 合并次数控制了符号化颗粒度和词汇大小与序列长度之间的权衡(kudo-2018-subword ). 合并过多产生零散的表示和长序,而太多的则产生大词汇,捕捉虚假或特定域的规律. 这种权衡会影响效率,因为较长的序列会增加变压器的注意力成本,而大的词汇会增加嵌入和解码间接费用.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate principled BPE merge selection from corpus statistics. We formulate merge selection as a model selection problem and explore information-theoretic criteria including AIC ( akaike-1974-anew ) , BIC ( schwarz-1978-estimating ) , and MDL ( rissanen-1978-modeling ; grunwald-2007-minimum ) , alongside entropy-based filtering methods. To improve estimation under limited data, we augment adaptation corpora with synthetic text generated from the original data, improving unigram and bigram coverage while reducing sparsity.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了原则BPE合并了从生物体统计中挑选出来的. 包括AIC(akaike-1974-anew),BIC(schwarz-1978-估测),以及MDL(rissanen-1978-modeling;grunwald-2007-Lindle), 为了在有限的数据下改进估计,我们用原始数据生成的合成文本来增强适应公司,提高单格和大度的覆盖率,同时减少垃圾。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) ( gage-1994-anewalgorithm ; sennrich-etal-2016-neural ) , WordPiece ( wu-2016-google ) , and Unigram Language Models ( kudo-2018-subword ) are widely used in modern language models. These methods construct vocabularies by iteratively merging or selecting subword units based on corpus statistics. In practice, the number of merges or vocabulary size is typically fixed heuristically, despite its strong impact on sequence length, compression efficiency and downstream performance ( dagan-etal-2024-getting ) .
blocks.zh: Byte-Pair编码(BPE)(gage-1994-anewalgorithm;sennrich-etal-2016-neural),WordPiece(wu-2016-google),Unigram语言模型(kudo-2018-subword)等子词符号化方法在现代语言模型中广泛使用. 这些方法通过迭代合并或根据实体统计选择子词单位来构建词汇. 在实践中,合并或词汇大小的数量一般是固定的,尽管其对序列长度,压缩效率和下游性能(dagan-etal-2024-getting )有强烈的影响.

blocks.en: Prior work has studied tokenizer adaptation in multilingual and domain-transfer settings, where vocabularies are modified or extended to improve coverage for new languages or domains ( sachidananda-etal-2021-efficient ; minixhofer-etal-2022-wechsel ; remy-etal-2024-transtokenization ) . Other studies have analyzed the tradeoff between vocabulary size, sequence length, and computational efficiency, showing that tokenizer design can significantly affect both training and inference cost ( sennrich-etal-2016-neural ; kudo-2018-subword ; zouhar-etal-2023-tokenization ; dagan-etal-2024-getting ) . In contrast to these approaches, we focus on selecting a compact subset of merges from an existing tokenizer rather than expanding or retraining the vocabulary. Closer to our work, ( meister-etal-2026-langmap ) trains language-adapted unigram models that all share the same underlying unit set, with which it is then possible to jointly perform tokenization and language identification.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作研究了在多语种和域传译环境中的代碼器适应,其中词汇表被修改或扩展,以提高新语言或域的覆盖范围(sachidananda-etal-2021-效率;mixhofer-etal-2022-wechsel;remy-etal-2024-transtokenization ). 其他研究也分析了词汇大小,序列长度,和计算效率之间的权衡,表明标语设计可以显著影响培训和推论成本(sennrich-etal-2016-neural;kudo-2018-subword;zouhar-etal-2023-tokenization;dagan-etal-2024-getting). 与这些方法相反,我们侧重于从现有的标语器中选择一个紧凑的合并子集,而不是扩展或再培训词汇。 更接近于我们的工作,(meister-etal-2026-langmap ) 训练语言适应的单语模型,它们都共享相同的基础单元集,然后可以与这些单元共同进行标语化和语言识别.

blocks.en: Information-theoretic criteria such as AIC, BIC ( akaike-1974-anew ; schwarz-1978-estimating ) , and Minimum Description Length (MDL) ( rissanen-1978-modeling ; grunwald-2007-minimum ) provide principled ways to balance model fit and complexity. These criteria have been widely used in statistical modeling and structure learning, but their application to subword tokenization has never, to the best of our knowledge, been considered. We leverage these criteria to formalize the problem of adaptation the vocabulary size to a given task.
blocks.zh: 信息理论标准,如AIC、BIC(akaike-1974-anew;schwarz-1978-Agesting )和最低描述长度(Risanen-1978-Modeling;grunwald-2007-English),提供了平衡模型适合性和复杂性的原则方法。 这些标准在统计建模和结构学习中被广泛使用,但它们在子词符号化中的应用,就我们所知,从来没有被考虑过. 我们利用这些标准,使词汇大小适应特定任务的问题正规化。

blocks.en: Data generation has been used to improve data coverage in low-resource and distributionally skewed settings. Recent work shows that large language models can generate synthetic corpora that improve robustness in downstream tasks ( anikina-etal-2025-rigorous ; luo-etal-2025-survey ) . In this work, we recourse to synthetic data to improve the estimation of token statistics for merge selection, particularly in low-resource and morphologically rich languages where sparsity affects frequency estimation.
blocks.zh: 数据生成被用于在资源匮乏和分布扭曲的环境中扩大数据覆盖面。 最近的工作表明,大型语言模型可以产生合成的蝎子,提高下游任务的稳健性(anikina-etal-2025-rigorous ;luo-etal-2025-survey ). 在这项工作中,我们利用合成数据来改进对合并选择的象征性统计数据的估计,特别是在资源少和形态丰富语言中,这些语言的螺旋性影响频率估计。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We address the problem of selecting an appropriate subset of BPE merge operations from an initial merge list. Given a training corpus 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , standard BPE recursively applies a sequence of N N merges, where N N is a predefined parameter which controls the final vocabulary size. This vocabulary is then used uniformly for all tasks, domains, and language. Our goal is to select an optimal subset of merges from this basic vocabulary, based on the statistics of some data 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , which can be the corpus used to train T T , or, as we consider in our experiments, an adaptation corpus used to trim the vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 我们处理从初始合并列表中选择一个合适的BPE合并操作子集的问题. 鉴于一个训练体D\mathcal{D},标准BPE递归性地应用了N N合并的序列,其中N N是一个预先定义的参数,控制最终词汇大小. 此词汇随后被统一用于所有的任务,域和语言. 我们的目标是根据一些数据D\ mathcal{D}的统计资料从这个基本词汇中选择一个最优的合并子集,这些数据可以是用来训练T T 的元件,或者,正如我们在实验中考虑的那样,是用来修剪词汇的适应体.

3.3 Merge Filtering Procedure
blocks.zh: 3.3 合并过滤程序

blocks.en: We interpret the BPE merging procedure as a sequence of local model updates, where each candidate merge introduces a new unit and modifies the corpus tokenization. Each merge therefore affects both the fit to the data (via changes in token frequencies and likelihood) and the model complexity (chiefly, via the vocabulary size).
blocks.zh: 我们把BPE合并程序解释为本地模式更新的序列,每个候选人合并后都引入一个新的单位,并修改了字母符号化。 因此,每次合并都会影响数据的适合性(通过符号频率和概率的变化)和模型复杂性(通过词汇大小).

blocks.en: We assume a existing BPE tokenizer, associated with a predefined merge list and decide which merge to keep or drop based on the following iterative procedure. At step j j , 𝒟 \mathcal{D}{} is tokenized with tokenizer T j − 1 T_{j-1} , and we need to evaluate merge μ j \mu_{j} (creating unit u j u_{j} ). For this, we compute: Δ ​ 𝒥 ​ ( μ j ) = 𝒥 ⁡ ( 𝒟 , T j ) − 𝒥 ⁡ ( 𝒟 , T j − 1 ) \Delta\mathcal{J}(\mu_{j})\;=\;\mathcal{J}(\mathcal{D};T_{j})\;-\;\mathcal{J}(\mathcal{D};T_{j-1}) with 𝒥 ⁡ ( 𝒟 , T J ) \mathcal{J}(\mathcal{D};T_{J}) a model selection criterion for tokenizer T j T_{j} . The merge is accepted if and only if: Δ ​ 𝒥 ​ ( μ j ) < 0 , \Delta\mathcal{J}(\mu_{j})<0, i.e., the improvement in data fit outweighs the increase in model complexity. Else, the merge is rejected and the next merge is evaluated. Note that rejecting a merge μ j \mu_{j} will automatically prevent any unit derived from u j u_{j} to be formed at a later stage, as u j u_{j} will have a null frequency. The procedure terminates when all merges have been evaluated. It is routine to check that the resulting merge list is valid ( berglund-vandermerwe-2023-formalizing ) as the validity property is an invariant property wich is maintained at all steps of the procedure.

blocks.en: The procedure sketched above is greedy, as it selects or rejects merges based on a local evaluation of their utility. Like for standard BPE, this process may create to junk units ( bostrom-durrett-2020-byte ) , which, once created, may participate in further merges that decrease their utility. We thus follow ( lian-2025-scaffold ) and adopt their refinement strategy, which performs a second filtering pass, unmerging, as it were, any unit whose global utility is too small.
blocks.zh: 上面描述的程序是贪婪的,因为它根据当地对其效用的评价来选择或拒绝合并. 和标准的BPE一样,这个过程可能创建到垃圾单元(bostrom-durrett-2020-byte),这些单位一旦创建,可能参与进一步合并,从而降低它们的效用. 因此,我们遵循(Lian-2025-scaffold)并采用其完善战略,即执行第二次过滤通过,照原样实现任何全球效用太小的单位。

blocks.en:
We now describe the full procedure used to select and refine BPE merges. The algorithm contain two phases: (i) a greedy filtering stage that selects merges based on the offset between goodness-of-fit and complexity,
and (ii) a scaffolding refinement stage that replaces low-utility merges with higher-frequency candidates based on corpus statistics.
The full procedure is formalized in Algorithm 1 (appendix 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们现在描述了用于选择和完善BPE合并的全部程序. 算法包含两个阶段:(一)一个贪婪的滤波阶段,它根据适配和复杂度之间的抵消来选择合并,
和(二) 采用脚手架式的改进阶段,以基于实体统计的频率较高的候选人取代低功率的合并。
完整程序在算法1(附录1)中正式确定.

blocks.en: 3.4 Synthetic Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.4 合成数据增强

blocks.en:
Our merge selection procedure applies irrespective of the nature of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , which can either be the original tokenizer training data, or a new corpus on which the model and its tokenizer need to be adapted. In the latter case, estimating merge utility from limited data can yield unmotivated choices, particularly for low-frequency or unseen bigrams.
In BPE-based adaptation algorithms, merges corresponding to zero-frequency bigrams are never considered, even if they are plausible under the underlying data distribution.
blocks.zh:
我们的合并选择程序不管D\ mathcal{D}的性质如何都适用,D\mathcal{D}既可以是原始的标致器训练数据,也可以是需要调整模型及其标致器的新工具。 在后一种情况下,从有限的数据中估计合并的效用可产生无动机的选择,特别是对于低频或看不见的bigrams。
在基于BPE的适应算法中,与0频率大调相对应的合并从未被考虑过,即使它们在基础数据分布下是可信的.

blocks.en:
To address this limitation, we augment the adaptation corpus 𝒜 \mathcal{A} with synthetic text generated from a pretrained LLM
. The goal is to better approximate the bigram distribution in the adaptation domain and to recover potentially useful merges that would otherwise remain undetected.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一限制,我们增加了A \ mathcal{A} 适应体,由经过预先训练的LLM生成合成文本。
。 。 。 目标是更好地估计适应领域的大块块分布,并恢复可能有用的合并,否则这些合并将无法被发现。

blocks.en:
We construct a synthetic corpus adaptation 𝒢 \mathcal{G} by sampling prefixes p ∈ 𝒜 p\in\mathcal{A} and generating continuations conditioned on these prefixes. Each prefix serves as a prompt to the LLM, yielding texts that preserve local syntactic and semantic structure, while also reflecting the peculiarities of the adaptation corpus.
In the sequel, we note the synthetic corpus derived from 𝒜 \mathcal{A} as 𝒜 G \mathcal{A}_{G} .
blocks.zh:
我们通过采样前缀 p\\ a\ in\ mathcal{A} 构建合成体适应 G\ mathcal{G} 并生成这些前缀的延续 。 每个前缀都起到LLM的提示作用,产生保留当地合成和语义结构的文本,同时也反映了适应体的特殊性.
在续集中,我们注意到从 A\ mathcal{A} 中衍生出来的合成体。

blocks.en: By aggregating generated continuations across diverse prefixes, the synthetic corpus approximates the underlying token distribution and increase support for rare or even unseen bigrams. Figure 1 illustrates this effect via increased bigram coverage and reduced singleton ratio, indicating lower distributional sparsity.
blocks.zh: 通过汇总各种前缀生成的续作,合成体近似于基本的代号分布,并增加了对稀有甚至看不见的比格拉姆的支持. 图1通过增加bigram覆盖率和降低单吨比来说明这种影响,表明分布性痉挛性较低。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Bigram distribution and singleton ratio computed for the EMEA English corpus. We compare using 10k original data ( 𝒜 \mathcal{A} ), 10k generated data ( 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ), and their combination ( 𝒜 ∪ 𝒢 \mathcal{A}\cup\mathcal{G} ).
blocks.zh: 图 1: Bigram 分布和单吨数比率,为欧洲经济、社会、文化权利协会的英文本。 我们使用10k的原始数据(A\ mathcal{A}),10k生成的数据(G\mathcal{G}),以及它们的组合(A\\G\mathcal{A\cup\mathcal{G})进行比较.

blocks.en: From a modeling perspective, synthetic data enables to smooth empirical counts and yields more robust estimation of merge utility. This is particularly important for statistical criteria such as AIC, BIC, and MDL, which depend on accurate likelihood estimates.
blocks.zh: 从建模的角度来看,合成数据能够顺利计算经验,对合并效用作出更强有力的估计。 这对统计标准特别重要,如国际统计学协会、国际统计学协会和多边统计学研究所,它们依赖于准确的可能性估计。

blocks.en:
In our experiments, we evaluate merge selection under three conditions: orig (original corpus only), gen (synthetic corpus only) and orig+gen (combined corpus).
This setup allows us to isolate the contribution of synthetic data and assess their impact on merge selection and downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们在三个条件下评价合并选择:orig(仅限原物),gen(仅限合成物)和orig+gen(合并物).
这个设置使我们能够隔离合成数据的贡献,并评估它们对合并选择和下游任务的影响.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Corpora
blocks.zh: 4.1 公司

blocks.en: We evaluate merge selection across multiple corpora covering both domain-specific and multilingual settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价多个公司的合并选择,涵盖特定域和多语种环境。

blocks.en: We use the EMEA corpus for English and French, 4 4 4 EMEA is the European Medicines Agency from the Opus collection https://opus.eu , ( tiedemann-2012-parallel ) . and the LER corpus for German. 5 5 5 LER is the German Legal Entity Recognition corpus of ( leitner-etal-2020-dataset ) . See: https://huggingface.co/datasets/german-tokenizer-benchmark/german-ler . These datasets provide controlled, domain-specific text suitable for analyzing tokenization under limited variability.
blocks.zh: 我们使用英语和法语的EMEA法则,4 4 4 EMEA是Opus收藏的欧洲医药机构https://opus.eu(bitemann-2012-并行)和德语的LERA法则. 5 5 LER是德国法律实体确认书(leitner-etal-2020-dataset ),见:https://huggingface.co/datasets/german-tokenizer-benchmark/german-ler. 这些数据集提供了受控的,特定域的文本,适合在有限的可变性下分析征兆化.

blocks.en: To assess robustness across languages, we again use subsets of the OPUS collection for English, Sinhala, and Swahili, representing varying levels of resource availability and morphological complexity. For each corpus, we construct training subsets of size 5k, 10k, 20k, and 50k sentences to study the effect of data scale on merge selection.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不同语言的稳健性,我们再次使用OPUS集合的子集用于英语,僧伽罗语和斯瓦希里语,代表着不同程度的资源可用性和形态复杂性. 对于每个实体,我们构建大小为5k,10k,20k,和50k的训练子集,研究数据尺度对合并选择的影响.

blocks.en: 4.2 Synthetic Data Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 合成数据生成

blocks.en: Synthetic text is generated using LLaMA-3.1-8B-instruct with nucleus sampling (top- p = 0.9 p=0.9 ) and temperature 0.7 0.7 . Each prompt consists of a 12-word prefix sampled from the original corpus, followed by an instruction to continue generation until sentence completion. For each prefix, we sample m m independent continuations with a maximum length of 64 tokens each.
blocks.zh: 合成文本使用LLaMA-3.1-8B-struct生成,其核取样(顶-p=0.9p=0.9)和温度0.70.7. 每个提示由从原物样本中抽取的12字前缀组成,然后指示继续生成直到句子完成. 对于每个前缀,我们抽取 m m 独立续作,每个最大长度为64个令牌.

blocks.en: 4.3 Tokenizer Construction
blocks.zh: 4.3 开关建筑

blocks.en:
All tokenizers are derived from a shared initial BPE merge list. Each selection strategy (AIC, BIC, MDL variants, VOLT) produces a filtered subset of merges.
To ensure comparability, all methods and baselines only differ in their selection criterion, and operate on the same initial merge inventory.
blocks.zh:
所有标致器都来源于共享的初始BPE合并列表. 每个选择策略(AIC,BIC,MDL变体,VOLT)产生一个过滤的子集合并.
为了确保可比性,所有方法和基线仅在选择标准上有所不同,并在相同的初始合并清单上运作。

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation: Tasks and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 评价:任务和计量

blocks.en:
We assess adapted tokenizer based on their ability to compress the adpatation corpus, i.e. to reduce the initial byte based representation (or character-based representation) into a shorter list of tokens. This can be measured in various ways (e.g., tokenizer fertility); in this work we rely on the compression utility , which measure the difference (in number of units) between the byte-based and token-based representations as a ratio of the original number of bytes or characters.
Additionally, we also evaluate the adapted tokenizers on downstream tasks that probe both understanding and generation.
blocks.zh:
我们根据其压缩代号的能力来评估改编的代号,即将初始字节代表(或字符代表)缩减为较短的代号清单. 这可以通过各种方式衡量(例如,标注符的生育力);在这项工作中,我们依赖于压缩效用,这个效用用来测量以字节为基础的表示值与以符号为基础的表示值之间的差(单位数),作为原字节数或字符数的比例.
此外,我们还评估对下游任务进行改造的标语器,以探索理解和生成。

blocks.en:
We evaluate multilingual understanding using the Belebele benchmark ( bandarkar-etal-2024-belebele ) . Performance in multiple choice question is measured using accuracy. For each example, the model is prompted with the passage, question and four candidate answers, and instructed to output one of the answer labels A , B , C , or D .
The predicted answer is obtained by extracting the generated choice label, then compared against the gold answer to compute accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Belebele基准(bandarkar-etal-2024-belebele)来评价多语种理解。 多个选择问题中的性能用精确度衡量. 对于每个例子,模型都以段落,问答和四个候选答案为提示,并指示输出一个答案标签A,B,C,或D.
预测的答案是通过提取生成的选择标签获得的,然后与黄金答案进行比较以计算准确性.

blocks.en: To assess generation, we use Machine Translation (MT). As MT requires (at least) two languages, we build the adaptation corpus (and the corresponding synthetic data) using a balanced subset of sentences sampled from the source and target corpus. We use Flores-200 for multilingual translation ( costajussa-etal-2024-scaling ) . Translation quality is measured in BLEU ( papineni-etal-2002-bleu ) implemented with sacreBLEU ( post-2018-call ) . 6 6 6 Signature: nrefs:1|case:mixed|eff:no|tok:13a| smooth:exp|version:2.5.1 We use greedy decoding with a maximum generation limit of 128 tokens for all models.

blocks.en: 4.5 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.5 基线

blocks.en: We compare our new merge selection strategies to Adapt-BPE ( pilana-liyanage-yvon-2026-adaptbpe ) , which also adapts a tokenizer to a target corpus, using a comparable merge budget. For all pruning-based approaches (Adapt-BPE, AIC, BIC, MDL-2-part, MDL-COMP, and VOLT), we use a fixed budget of 15k merges to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们将新的合并选择策略比作Adapt-BPE(pilana-liyanage-yvon-2026-adaptbpe), 对所有基于奔跑的方法(Adapt-BPE、AIC、BIC、MDL-2部分、MDL-COMP和VOLT),我们使用15k合并的固定预算来确保公平比较。

blocks.en: 4.6 Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.6 实验议定书

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We present results across three evaluation dimensions: compression utility (CU), reading comprehension (RC), and machine translation (MT).
blocks.zh: 我们提出三个评价层面的成果:压缩工具(CU)、阅读理解(RC)和机器翻译(MT)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Compression Utility
blocks.zh: 5.1 压缩工具

blocks.en: Figure 2: CU values for each strategy, corpus types and sizes in English, French and German.
blocks.zh: 图2:英文、法文和德文中每项战略、实体类型和大小的CU值。

blocks.en: Figure 2 reports CU for English, French, and German corpora of varying sizes. For these experiments, we used the Llama-3 tokenizer (128k) as the initial tokenizer. For all languages, the 15k-baseline consistently achieves the highest compression utility, reflecting the advantage of a large predefined merge budget. However, all selection-based methods operate with much smaller vocabularies - only retaining between 3 times and 10 times less units (full numbers for the 50k adaptation corpus are in Table 1 ). Although VOLT generally retains a larger number of merges than the information-theoretic methods, it does not consistently achieve the highest CU. This suggests that the effectiveness of merge selection depends not only on the number of retained merges but also on selecting the most informative ones, where MDL-COMP and AIC provide a better tradeoff between vocabulary size and compression.
blocks.zh: 图2报告了不同大小的英文、法文和德文公司的CU。 对于这些实验,我们使用Llama-3的标致剂(128k)作为初始标致剂. 对于所有语言来说,15k-基线一致实现最高的压缩效用,反映了大型预定义合并预算的优势. 然而,所有以选择为基础的方法的操作词汇都小得多----只保留3倍到10倍的单位(50k适应体的全部数字见表1)。 尽管VOLT一般保留比信息理论方法更多的合并,但它并没有一贯地实现最高的CU. 这表明合并选择的有效性不仅取决于保留合并的数量,也取决于选择信息最丰富的合并,其中MDL-COMP和AIC在词汇大小和压缩之间提供了更好的权衡.

blocks.en: Among the adaptive selection methods, VOLT and AIC consistently outperform MDL-* and BIC , yielding larger unit sets, especially for the original corpus. In particular, BIC tends to underfit, selecting smaller vocabularies that lead to lower CU than the other methods. We also observe variance across languages, owing to the initial vocabulary content for those languages.
blocks.zh: 在适应性选择方法中,VOLT和AIC的性能一贯高于MDL-*和BIC,产生更大的单位集,特别是原体。 特别是BIC倾向于不适应,选择比其他方法更小的词汇,导致CU更低. 我们还观察到不同语言之间的差异,因为这些语言最初的词汇内容。

blocks.en: 5.2 Reading Comprehension
blocks.zh: 5.2 阅读理解

blocks.en: Table 1 reports accuracy on the Belebele benchmark across multiple languages.
blocks.zh: 表1报告Belebele多种语文基准的准确性。

blocks.en: Table 1: RC results (Accuracy). For AIC, BIC, MDL and VOLT, merge lists are filtered using a corpus of 50k lines.
blocks.zh: 表1:驻地协调员结果(准确性)。 对于AIC,BIC,MDL和VOLT,合并列表使用50k行的集合进行过滤.

blocks.en: In these experiments, the full tokenizer achieves the highest accuracy across the board, followed by the fixed-15k baseline. Among the selection strategies, VOLT and MDL-based methods (particularly MDL-COMP) consistently outperform AIC and BIC.
blocks.zh: 在这些实验中,全标机实现全标最高的精度,其次是固定15k基线. 在选择战略中,基于VOLT和MDL的方法(特别是MDL-COMP)的业绩始终高于AIC和BIC。

blocks.en: The performance gap between large and reduced vocabularies is significant for high-resource languages. For the two LR languages (sin and swh), for which the baseline performance is low, it is possible to perform a very agressive vocabulary pruning with little impact on performance, sometimes even outperforming the baseline. This highlights the unfairness of the initial tokenizer, which allocates a lots of units to improve the tokenization of HR languages, while the LR languages are comparatively less well served.
blocks.zh: 对高资源语言而言,大字节和小字节之间的性能差距很大。 对于基线性能低的两种LR语言(sin和swh)来说,可以进行非常具有侵略性的词汇挤压,对性能影响不大,有时甚至比基线差. 这凸显了最初的标致器的不公平性,它分配了很多单元来改善HR语言的标致化,而LR语言的服务则相对较差.

blocks.en: We further observe that BPE scaffolding consistently improves performance across nearly all filtering strategies and data settings. The gains are particularly noticeable for VOLT and MDL-based methods.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步注意到,生物浓缩设备脚手架在几乎所有过滤战略和数据设置方面都不断改进业绩。 在基于VOLT和MDL的方法方面,这些收益尤其显著。

blocks.en: Finally, synthetic data again provides modest but consistent improvements when combined with actual data.
blocks.zh: 最后,合成数据在结合实际数据时,再次提供适度但一致的改进。

The full tokenizer and the 15k Adapt-BPE baseline achieve the strongest overall performance, confirming the advantage of larger merge inventories. Among the selection-based approaches, however, VOLT and MDL-COMP consistently outperform AIC and BIC, despite relying on substantially smaller vocabularies.
Here again, scaffolding consistently improves BLEU scores across nearly all selection strategies. The gains are particularly strong for VOLT and MDL-based methods, indicating that greedy merge filtering alone may discard useful subword units that can later be recovered through refinement.

blocks.en: Synthetic data also provides clear benefits. Across most settings, the orig+gen condition achieves the best performance , especially for smaller corpora, suggesting that generated text improves estimation of low-frequency and previously unseen token patterns. These improvements are particularly important in the Sinhala-English setting, where limited adaptation data makes merge estimation more sensitive to sparsity.
blocks.zh: 合成数据也提供明显的好处。 在大多数设置中,orig+gen条件能实现最佳性能,尤其是对于较小的corpora来说,这表明生成的文本可以改善对低频率和以前未见的象征图案的估计. 这些改进在僧伽罗语-英语语境中特别重要,因为有限的适应数据使得合并估计对斯帕氏语更为敏感.

blocks.en: Interestingly, larger vocabularies do not always yield better translation quality. For example, AIC often selects more merges than MDL-COMP while achieving lower BLEU scores.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,较大的词汇并不总是能产生更好的翻译质量。 例如,AIC经常选择比MDL-COMP更多的合并,同时实现较低的BLEU分数.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results provide several key insights into the problem of tokenizer capacity selection and the role of statistical criteria in guiding BPE merge selection.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果对象征性能力选择问题和统计标准在指导生物浓缩设备合并选择方面的作用提出了若干关键见解。

blocks.en: Across all experiments, we find that treating merge selection as a model selection problem leads to compact vocabularies that retain strong performance. While the fixed-15k baseline achieves the highest scores due to its large predefined merge budget, selection-based methods are able to identify significantly smaller vocabularies that remain competitive across tasks, at a much reduced computational costs. Large merge budgets are not always necessary, and principled selection criteria can yield efficient tokenizer with adaptive vocabulary sizes.
blocks.zh: 在所有实验中,我们发现,将合并选择作为一个模型选择问题来对待,会导致紧凑的词汇,保留强大的性能. 虽然固定的15k基线因其庞大的预定义合并预算而达到最高分数,但基于选择的方法能够识别出在任务之间仍然具有竞争力的显著较小的词汇,从而大大降低计算成本. 大型合并预算并非总有必要,原则性选择标准可以产生适应性词汇大小的高效示意剂.

blocks.en: Different selection criteria exhibit distinct behaviors. BIC consistently selects smaller vocabularies, often leading to underfitting due to its strong complexity penalty. AIC allows larger vocabularies, but does not consistently translate this into improved downstream performance. In contrast, MDL-based methods, particularly MDL-COMP, provide a more balanced tradeoff, adapting effectively to different data sizes. VOLT also performs competitively for all tasks.
blocks.zh: 不同的选择标准表现出不同的行为。 BIC一贯选择更小的词汇,由于它具有很强的复杂性处罚,往往导致配音不足. AIC允许更大的词汇,但并不一贯地将其转化为下游性能的改善. 相比之下,基于MDL的方法,特别是MDL-COMP,提供了更平衡的权衡,有效地适应了不同的数据大小. VOLT也对所有任务进行竞争性执行.

blocks.en: The scaffolding refinement stage consistently improves results across all criteria. This confirms that purely greedy merge selection is unefficient, as early decisions may exclude useful merges. By replacing low-frequency merges with high-frequency candidates, scaffolding introduces a form of global correction, leading to better merge inventories.
blocks.zh: 脚手架的改进阶段不断改进所有标准的成果。 这证实了纯粹贪婪的合并选择是无效的,因为早期的决定可能会排除有用的合并. 通过用高频考生取代低频合并,脚手架引入了一种全球校正形式,导致更好的合并库存.

blocks.en: Synthetic data improves merge selection, with consistent gains observed across CU, MT, and RC, particularly when combined with natural data (orig+gen setting).
blocks.zh: 合成数据改进了合并选择,在CU、MT和RC之间观察到了一致的收益,特别是在与自然数据(orig+gen设定)结合时。

blocks.en: This supports the interpretation of synthetic data as a distributional prior that reduces sparsity and provides better estimates of rare or unseen token combinations, which is especially important for statistical criteria relying on accurate likelihood estimation. Increasing the amount of synthetic data further improves performance, indicating that merge selection benefits from increasingly better approximations of the underlying distribution.
blocks.zh: 这支持将合成数据解释为分配前数据,减少螺旋性,更好地估计稀有或看不见的符号组合,这对依靠准确概率估计的统计标准尤为重要。 增加合成数据的数量进一步提高了性能,表明结合选择的好处是基础分布的近似性越来越强.

blocks.en: We observe that different tasks exhibit different sensitivities to tokenization. Machine translation is relatively robust to vocabulary reduction, whereas reading comprehension is more sensitive, particularly in a multilingual setting, as token fragmentation can affect the representation of rare words, named entities, and morphologically complex forms required for precise semantic matching. In contrast, translation can compensate for increased fragmentation through contextual generation and compositional decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,不同的任务显示出不同的敏感性。 机器翻译在减少词汇方面相对稳健,而阅读理解则比较敏感,特别是在多语种环境下,因为符号分裂会影响稀有词的表示,命名实体,以及精确语义匹配所需的形态复杂形式. 相比之下,翻译可以通过上下文生成和组成解码来弥补碎片化的增加.

blocks.en: This suggests that tasks requiring precise semantic matching may benefit from fine-grained tokenization, while generative tasks can tolerate more compact representations. Future work could quantify this sensitivity by relating performance degradation under controlled vocabulary reduction to token-level properties such as fertility, named entity fragmentation, and morphological complexity.
blocks.zh: 这表明,要求精确语义匹配的任务可能得益于精细的纹理化,而基因化的任务可以容忍更紧凑的表达. 今后的工作可以通过将受控词汇减少下的性能退化与象征性特性(如生育力、命名的实体分裂和形态复杂性)联系起来来量化这种敏感性。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied BPE merge inventory selection from a statistical model selection perspective, framing tokenizer capacity as a tradeoff between data likelihood and model complexity through criteria such as AIC, BIC, MDL, and entropy-based objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们从统计模型选择的角度研究了BPE将清单选择合并,通过AIC,BIC,MDL等标准,将标定器能力设定为数据可能性和模型复杂性之间的一种权衡.

blocks.en: Across multiple corpora and languages, these criteria produce compact vocabularies that remain competitive on downstream tasks while requiring substantially fewer merges than fixed-budget tokenizers. MDL-based objectives and VOLT provide the most consistent balance between compression efficiency and task performance.
blocks.zh: 在多种公司和语言中,这些标准产生了紧凑的词汇表,这些词汇表在下游任务上仍然具有竞争力,而要求的合并比固定预算代号要少得多。 基于MDL的目标和VOLT在压缩效率和任务性能之间提供了最一致的平衡.

blocks.en: We further show that synthetic data improves merge selection by providing better token statistics, reducing sparsity and improving coverage of rare or unseen combinations, particularly for low-resource and morphologically rich languages.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步表明,合成数据改善合并选择,提供更好的象征性统计数据,减少痉挛现象,扩大稀有或看不见的组合的覆盖范围,特别是针对资源少和形态丰富的语言。

blocks.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that tokenizer design benefits from principled statistical selection rather than heuristic merge budgets. Downstream performance does not scale monotonically with vocabulary size, and compact inventories can preserve task performance under constrained computational resources.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的结果显示,象征性设计受益于原则性统计选择,而不是热心合并预算。 下游的性能并不单调地以词汇大小进行规模化,而紧凑的目录可以在有限的计算资源下保留任务性能.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation relies on unigram model to select an optimal unit set, that we then apply to a BPE vocabulary construction process. The choice to combine two techniques makes it easy to implement an incremental vocabulary growth; it also makes our approach fully with complementary techniques such as BPE-scaffolding. However, it certainly yields to suboptimal unit sets. An alternative would be to keep BPE as a way to incrementally extend the set of units, and to perform tokenization with the unigram model.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价依赖于unigram模型来选择一个最佳的单元集,然后我们应用到BPE词汇构建过程中. 选择结合两种技术,可以容易地实施递增的词汇增长;它也使我们的方法与BPE-脚手架等互补技术充分结合. 然而,它当然会达到低于最佳的单位。 另一种办法是保留BPE,作为逐步扩展成套单元的一种方式,并采用单格模型进行标识。

blocks.en: Finally, our evaluation is limited to translation and reading comprehension benchmarks, and future work should consider broader tasks and large-scale language model training settings. In addition, evaluating across a wider variety of pretrained tokenizers, model architectures, and languages, particularly underrepresented and morphologically diverse languages, would provide a more comprehensive understanding of the generality and limitations of adaptive vocabulary refinement.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的评价仅限于翻译和阅读理解基准,今后的工作应考虑更广泛的任务和大规模语文模式培训环境。 此外,对各种经过预先培训的标语、示范建筑和语言,特别是代表性不足和形态多样性的语言进行评价,将使人们更全面地了解适应性词汇改进的通用性和局限性。
